caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless vest rendered in pale blue with visible fine crosshatching and texture indicating woven fabric. The vest features a soft, light lining visible around the armholes and inner collar, which is off-white in color. There are four buttons vertically aligned down the front, and two small rectangular pockets, one on each side near the bottom hem. The vest appears slightly rumpled, suggesting a soft or worn fabric. Below the vest, a rectangular swatch displaying the same pale blue woven texture is included, illustrating the fabric pattern in more detail. The background of the drawing is a neutral light beige, and the vest and swatch are neatly centered within a lightly inked rectangular border.
title: Vest
